title: Kako Auto-201 Shoe Mount Universal Flash Unit - Used, Untested
descriptionText: The Kako Auto-201 Shoe Mount Universal Flash Unit is a vintage flash unit made in Japan by the brand Kako. It features a zoom function and is designed to be compatible with a wide range of camera brands. Despite being untested, this shoe mount flash unit offers a convenient and versatile option for photographers looking to enhance their lighting setup.
